about: Boss tactics for the Isaac bot: how experienced players beat each floor 1-2 boss without taking damage, written as fields code can use. Readable version and sources: BOSSES.md. Companion to enemy_playbook.json (same type.variant keys).
version_rule: Repentance+ behaviour wins where versions differ.
key_format: type.variant, same as enemy_playbook.json and hits.jsonl. Multi-part bosses have one entry per part, linked by part_of.
units: distances in px (1 grid tile = 40 px; a 1x1 room's floor is about 520 x 280 px). Frames are animation frames as logged in tells.dat (shots@Nf = shots leave N frames into the animation).

fields.pref_dist: px to keep from this entity's centre (minimum, not exact). The bot's current boss default is boss_dist 150.
fields.avoid_row_col: true = never stand on its row or column (attack fires or charges along cardinal lines when Isaac lines up).
fields.avoid_row: true = only its row matters (horizontal charges / horizontal beams).
fields.avoid_diagonals: true = never stand on its 45-degree diagonals (X-pattern attacks).
fields.stay_diagonal: true = prefer spots diagonal to it (off both row and column).
fields.avoid_corners: true = don't fight from a corner (bounces, dashes or slams pin Isaac there).
fields.room_zone: where to fight: any | open (most free space around Isaac) | center (circle the room centre) | bottom_half (stay below the room's middle row) | far_side (opposite half from the boss).
fields.attack_windows: animation names during which it is safe to stand and shoot, or 'always'. Names marked in anims_logged were seen by the bot (tells.dat); others are descriptions until tells.lua logs the real names.
fields.dodge: list of {attack, tell, tell_anim (list of animation names, or null if unknown), fires (animation the shots/charge come out in), shots_at_frame, shots, how, notes}.
fields.how: sideways = step 90 degrees off the attack's line | away = add distance | diagonal = get off its row and column | behind_rocks = put an obstacle between | keep_moving = never stop (aimed at where Isaac is / lands on him) | no_reverse = keep going the same way (shot lands where Isaac was; doubling back walks into it) | change_direction = turn or stop (shot is led at where Isaac will be if he keeps going) | off_creep = leave and avoid creep.
fields.adds: ignore | kill_first | kill_close (kill only when near Isaac or in the line of fire anyway). adds_ids gives the rule per add type.
fields.target_order: kill order for multi-part bosses (first = shoot first).
fields.never_aim: ids not worth shooting (invulnerable or die with the boss).
fields.invulnerable_while: animation names or conditions during which shots are wasted.
fields.on_death: attack fired when it dies (keep dodging after the kill).
fields.confidence: wiki = from the wiki page | logs = from the bot's own tells.dat / bench | inferred = reasoned from the mechanic, test it.
fields.bench: the bot's bench result before this file (old careful play, 90 s limit, item-free).

notes: Jumpers (lift-off, off-screen leaps) land on Isaac's position: move when they leave the ground and keep moving until they land, then step off the creep.
Lobbed shots (Ipecac-style: Sloth, Headless Horseman body, Pin) fly high and only hurt where they land; predict the landing at Isaac's position when fired and keep 60+ px from it when it comes down.
Ring and radial bursts have bigger gaps farther out: distance is the dodge.
Aimed spreads (3-shot, 5-shot): step sideways, don't back straight away along the line.
Creep (effect 1000.22 red, 1000.25 white slows, 1000.56 brown) is a no-go floor area for several seconds after it appears.

261.0.name: Dingle
261.0.bench: died with 6 hits; logged causes about half puke shots (9.3) and half body contact (261.0)

dodge.shots: 3 puke shots (projectile 9.3) aimed at Isaac
dodge.notes: Shots leave only 3 frames into Spit: start the sidestep on Dance/Whistle, not on Spit. 3 of the logged Dingle hits came during Spit.

dodge.shots: 3 long dashes, each aimed at Isaac, bouncing off walls and rocks
dodge.notes: Sidestep late at 90 degrees to its line; never run along the dash line or into a corner. Wait for the whole sequence (it ends in Tired) before closing in.

dodge.shots: 1-3 Dips, then a triple shot at once
dodge.notes: Whistle is always followed by Spit: treat it as the triple-shot tell too.

261.0.champions: Black: 8-shot ring instead of 3 (stand off its rows, columns and diagonals), spiders instead of Dips, one very fast dash. Red: 4 shorter, slower dashes, red poop instead of Dips.
261.0.notes: Stationary except for dashes, so shoot it from range while it Idles; Tired after the dashes is the free window. Dashes knock Dips around and can leave a Poop that blocks shots. The bot's lack of a fixed firing spot for dashers (reflex.lua) is right for this boss.
261.0.confidence: wiki + logs; tell timing from logs

261.1.name: Dangle

dodge.tell: Dance/Whistle before Spit (same rig as Dingle, unconfirmed)
dodge.shots: 3 shots at Isaac
2 long dashes leaving slippery brown creep; sometimes a Corn Mine at the start
dodge.notes: Brown creep is slippery; don't plan a sidestep across it. If the Corn Mine poisons it mid-dash it leaves damaging green creep: off_creep.

261.1.notes: Dingle with Brownie Corns instead of Dips, 2 dashes instead of 3, and the most HP of any chapter 1 boss. Spawns about 1/4 as often as Dingle.
261.1.confidence: wiki; animation names assumed shared with Dingle

79.0.name: Gemini: Contusion (big twin)
79.0.bench: timed out with 4 hits (big twin contact 79.0, one Suture shot 9.0, one Suture contact 79.10)

dodge.tell: keeps speeding up in WalkHori/WalkVert, ends in Pant
dodge.shots: contact
dodge.notes: Circle the room centre at 180+ px; when it speeds up, cut 90 degrees across its path instead of running ahead of it. Pant (catching breath) follows the charge: shoot then.

79.0.phase_change: If Contusion dies first, Suture detaches and charges furiously with high momentum (and tear knockback speeds it up). If Suture dies first nothing changes. So kill Suture first.
79.0.champions: Blue: Suture fires homing shots (behind_rocks, keep_moving). Green: the twins start apart.
79.0.notes: Type 79 animations are logged together for both twins: WalkHori/WalkVert/Pant look like Contusion, Walk01/Attack01 like attached Suture, Rage -> Walk02 like Suture detaching. Never fight it from a corner: it chases into you and Suture swings around it.
79.0.confidence: wiki + logs; kill order from the wiki's phase rule

79.10.name: Gemini: Suture (small twin)

dodge.shots: 1 projectile at Isaac; blocked by obstacles
dodge.notes: 17 frames of warning: sidestep as Attack01 starts. A rock between Isaac and Suture blocks it (behind_rocks).

dodge.shots: contact, high momentum
dodge.notes: Only happens if Contusion dies first. It overshoots: sidestep late, don't knock it back toward Isaac with tears from close.

79.10.phase_change: Detaches and charges if Contusion dies first.
79.10.notes: Kill this one first. It is on a cord around Contusion, so standing 180+ px from Contusion also keeps Isaac out of the cord circle.

79.1.name: Steven (big)

dodge.shots: contact
dodge.notes: Same as Contusion.

79.1.phase_change: At 50% of big Steven's HP the twins separate; Steven Baby then charges furiously.
79.1.on_death: Big Steven fires two rows of 8 slow projectiles that pass over obstacles and leave the screen (whole heart each): be far away (away) and step through a gap. Steven Baby fires 8 outward.
79.1.notes: Gemini's unlockable twin. The separation at 50% happens anyway, so killing the baby early matters even more. Keep dodging after each death burst.

dodge.shots: 1 shot at Isaac, blocked by obstacles

79.2.name: Blighted Ovum: Contusion

dodge.tell: speeds up (no breather in this version)
dodge.shots: contact; leaves a red creep trail
dodge.notes: Its trail is red creep (1000.22): don't circle back over its own path.

79.2.phase_change: none; killing Contusion kills the ghost Suture too.
79.2.notes: Only Contusion can be hurt. The danger is the ghost Suture's horizontal beam (see 79.12): never be level with it.

79.12.name: Blighted Ovum: Suture (ghost)

dodge.tell: Isaac level with it to its left or right
dodge.shots: laser along its row
dodge.notes: Fires whenever Isaac is on its row: keep a full tile (40+ px) above or below its row at all times. It floats slowly toward Isaac.

79.12.notes: Invincible ghost; dies when Contusion dies. Never waste shots on it.

260.0.name: The Haunt
260.0.bench: timed out with 2 hits; died with 4 on a copy. Most hits were Lil Haunts (260.10)

dodge.shots: body and orbiting Lil Haunts hurt on touch even while see-through
dodge.notes: Keep 160+ px from the Haunt itself in phase 1 and fight the chasing Lil Haunt away from it.

dodge.shots: it flies to the upper wall; the move can hit
dodge.notes: When the last Lil Haunt dies, get out of the line between it and the top wall.

dodge.shots: laser down its column
dodge.notes: 2 logged hits came from LaserNoSkin. It slides left/right along the top wall, so its column moves: keep 60+ px sideways from its column whenever it can laser, and don't step under it.

dodge.shots: 5 shots in a downward fan
dodge.notes: Gaps widen with distance: being low in the room makes the fan easy.

dodge.shots: fast contact dash
dodge.notes: Only when Isaac is near the top wall: stay in the bottom half.

260.0.phase_change: Phase 1: invulnerable; 3 Lil Haunts orbit it and one at a time comes after Isaac. Phase 2 (all Lil Haunts dead): it peels its skin, goes to the upper wall and slides left/right, lasering and spitting downward.
260.0.champions: Black: 2 Lil Haunts; phase 2 spawns 1-2 spiders instead of the laser. Pink: 1 Lil Haunt; phase 2 has 100 HP, two diagonal lasers that bounce once off walls (avoid_diagonals), 8 aimed shots.
260.0.notes: Phase 2 shooting spot: bottom half of the room, offset 60+ px from its column, shooting up and leading it as it slides (it moves into the tears). It can get stuck trying to reach a spot and then stops attacking. Idle/Float/FloatChase/Shoot in the type-260 log are the Lil Haunts.

260.10.name: Lil Haunt

dodge.shots: blood shot aimed at where Isaac will be if he keeps moving
dodge.notes: Because the shot is led, keeping the same direction walks into it: turn or stop when Shoot starts. 4 frames of warning only, so watch for it slowing down.

dodge.shots: mirrors Isaac's movement while chasing
dodge.notes: It copies Isaac's movement: zig-zag to open a firing line.

260.10.notes: 25 HP, dies fast; only the one that left the orbit is worth shooting. The orbiting ones circle the invulnerable Haunt and still hurt on touch.

237.1.name: Gurglings
237.1.bench: cleared in 89 s with 3 hits (2 of them red creep 1000.22, 1 body)

dodge.tell: none: Walk* switches straight to Charge* when Isaac lines up
dodge.shots: fast dash along the row/column toward Isaac until it hits a wall, leaving red creep
dodge.notes: No wind-up, so avoidance has to be pre-emptive: stay off both Gurglings' rows and columns. With two of them, if a line can't be avoided, share a line only with the farther one.

dodge.shots: red creep (1000.22) along the whole dash path
dodge.notes: 2 of the 3 bench hits. Treat every dash path as a wall for a few seconds.

237.1.phase_change: none; each Gurgling acts on its own.
237.1.champions: Black: troll bombs instead of creep, no flies. Yellow: three of them, faster, no creep, no flies.
237.1.notes: After hitting a wall it pauses (Stop) and spawns 0-2 Attack Flies: that pause is the safe time to shoot it. Trick (inferred): at long range, step onto its line and straight back off; it rushes into the wall and stops, giving a free window. An Attack Fly in its path stops the dash. 60 HP each, so the slow bench clear was missed windows, not toughness.

237.2.name: Turdlings

dodge.shots: dash to the wall, leaving slippery brown creep
4 Brownie Corns fly out in the 4 cardinal directions from where it stopped
dodge.notes: Right after it stops, get off its row and column again.

dodge.shots: knockback near it

237.2.notes: Gurglings with brown creep and corn shots. About 1/4 as common as Gurglings.
237.2.confidence: wiki; animation names assumed shared with Gurglings

46.0.name: Sloth
46.0.bench: timed out with 5 hits (7 of 8 logged hits were 46.0: its shot)

dodge.shots: 1 lobbed explosive (Ipecac) projectile at Isaac's position when fired; hurts where it lands (a whole heart)
dodge.notes: This is why the bot saw danger 0 before the hits: the shot is high in the air and only hurts on landing (logged hits came during WalkHori/WalkVert, after the Attack). Keep moving the same way; doubling back walks into the blast. Predict the landing at the spot Isaac stood when Attack fired and stay 60+ px away from it.

dodge.shots: a Charger that charges horizontally in the direction Sloth faces, then acts as a normal Charger
dodge.notes: Never stand on Sloth's row; then the new Charger misses.

46.0.champions: Super Sloth (floors 3-4): two Ipecac shots and two spiders at a time.
46.0.notes: Its body is slow; the shot is the danger. Often comes with two Chargers, Splashers or Attack Flies. The wiki strategy is to keep moving in one direction: doubling back to dodge Chargers is what gets players hit by the Ipecac.

264.0.name: Mega Fatty
264.0.bench: 3 hits on a Caves I copy, all 264.0 (blood bursts at 85-92 px)

dodge.shots: lands on Isaac's position, big red creep puddle
dodge.notes: Move as Jumping starts and keep going until Landing; then stay off the puddle (off_creep).

dodge.shots: contact and creep
pulls Isaac and nearby enemies toward him
dodge.notes: Walk straight away from him for the whole Sucking animation so the pull doesn't drag Isaac into contact or fart range.

dodge.shots: shots go up and rain down for a while, following Isaac
dodge.notes: Never stop during the rain; shots fall where Isaac is heading less than where he is.

dodge.shots: hurts close by, then 1-3 Dips or a cluster of shots
dodge.notes: 21 frames of warning. The bench hits came from 85-92 px: keep 170 px.

264.0.champions: Brown: no vomit; long jump sends rock waves. Red: smaller, 6 shots on landing instead of creep, four shot streams instead of the vomit rain.
264.0.notes: Not a floor 1-2 boss in Repentance+ (Caves / Flooded Caves), but it's on the bench. 600 HP makes it long: shoot in every window from 170 px.

20.0.name: Monstro

dodge.tell: stops and opens its mouth (name unknown)
dodge.shots: big spread of mixed shots toward Isaac
dodge.notes: Move across the cone, not back along it.

dodge.shots: lands on Isaac's spot, then a burst in all directions
dodge.notes: Keep moving while it's off-screen and be 120+ px from the landing for the ring.

dodge.shots: contact

20.0.notes: Big tears hurt a full heart, small ones half. Grey champion: more spit, no off-screen jump. Red: two small Monstros.

19.0.name: Larry Jr.

dodge.tell: moves in straight cardinal lines, turning at walls, rocks and poop
dodge.shots: contact
dodge.notes: Never stand in front of the head on its current line; don't get boxed in by its body and poop.

19.0.notes: Drops poop as it moves; shooting poop turns it. Long segments can split into a new worm. Piercing tears hit several segments. Green champion: shoots in its facing direction after a pause.

67.0.name: The Duke of Flies

dodge.shots: orbiting Attack Flies sent out to chase Isaac
dodge.notes: Kill flies as they come; keep the fly count low so it never reaches the release.

67.0.on_death: Releases its orbiters and (Repentance) spawns 6 more flies: keep fighting after the kill.
67.0.notes: Floats diagonally and bounces off walls (avoid corners). Orbiting flies block shots. Green champion: Moters and 8-way blood shots. Orange: Suckers.

99.0.name: Gurdy Jr.

dodge.shots: fast slide at Isaac, bouncing off walls, then slows to a stop
dodge.notes: Below 50% HP it charges nonstop.

dodge.shots: 8 shots in a ring on landing

99.0.notes: The wiki lists it as a chapter 2 boss (the playbook's floors 1-2 tag looks wrong). An active bomb slows its charge a lot.

100.0.name: Widow

dodge.shots: lands near Isaac
dodge.notes: Sped up in Repentance.

dodge.shots: white creep (slows) + a Sack (max 3), or spits a Spider
dodge.notes: White creep (1000.25) slows Isaac: never dodge across it.

100.0.notes: It can crush its own Spiders and Sacks by landing on them. Black champion: big spiders and 6 blood shots. Pink: Boils and Attack Flies, faster jumps.

62.0.name: Pin
attack_windows: while the head is out of the ground

dodge.tell: underground, then bursts out at Isaac
dodge.shots: contact; medium jumps fire 4 diagonal shots on exit, long jumps fire again in the air
dodge.notes: Never stand still while it is under. Off its diagonals when it surfaces.

dodge.shots: red lobbed explosive shot
dodge.notes: Lobbed: predict the landing. After this attack Pin always jumps out of that same spot next: keep away from it.

62.0.notes: Every segment can be hurt. It can't cross gaps. Grey champion (Repentance): bigger, 6-shot spiral burst.

908.0.name: Baby Plum

dodge.shots: diagonal stream with some big shots
rotating spiral
dodge.notes: Circle the same way the spiral turns.

dodge.shots: inner ring of 14 slow random shots + outer ring of 8 fast shots on cardinals and diagonals, small red creep
dodge.notes: Stand off her rows, columns and diagonals and far away for the slam.

908.0.notes: Trick: if she takes no damage for 30 s she flies away (spared) and the item becomes Plum Flute. Killing her is faster and gives a normal boss item, so the bot should just kill her.

63.0.name: Famine

dodge.tell: Isaac on its row (it lines up with Isaac when it has 2 Pooters)
dodge.shots: charges across the screen, exits, comes back from the far side
dodge.notes: Stay off its row. Mid-room vertically makes the charges easy.

dodge.shots: 3-shot spread
dodge.notes: Move slowly up and down; shots go where Isaac was.

63.0.phase_change: After enough damage the body explodes; the head drifts toward Isaac and fires 3-shot spreads.
63.0.notes: Blue champion: charges more often and veers toward Isaac, 6-way shots.

81.0.name: The Fallen

dodge.shots: 3-shot spread then 4-shot spread

dodge.tell: speeds up and chases, then halts
dodge.shots: Brimstone in all 4 cardinal directions
dodge.notes: When it halts, be diagonal to it.

81.0.phase_change: At 50% it splits into two smaller copies; both must die.
81.0.notes: Only appears after a Devil Room was entered (devil room pool).

82.0.name: Headless Horseman (body)

dodge.shots: Ipecac-like shots that leave a big red creep puddle where they land
dodge.notes: Predict the landing; then off_creep.

82.0.notes: Head and body are separate (83.0 is the head).

dodge.tell: Isaac to its left or right
dodge.shots: charges left/right off-screen and back 1-3 times
dodge.notes: Stay off its row.

dodge.shots: 3 shots at Isaac

404.0.name: Little Horn
attack_windows: always while out of a hole

dodge.shots: pitfalls; teleport pitfalls that move outward
dodge.notes: Never stand still; never walk onto a Pitfall.

dodge.tell: throws a bomb into a hole
dodge.shots: troll or mega troll bomb pops out near Isaac
dodge.notes: Get 100+ px from any troll bomb (4.3) before it blows.

404.0.notes: Keeps away from Isaac. Its own bombs hurt it (25 in Repentance). Pitfalls can stay after it dies. Dark Ball spawns: kill when close.

405.0.name: Rag Man

dodge.shots: homing
dodge.notes: Keep moving and put rocks between; homing shots curve around a straight sidestep.

dodge.shots: head rolls at Isaac, then becomes a Ragling
dodge.notes: The head has 25 HP and damage to it also hurts Rag Man.

405.0.notes: Revives Raglings and heals 10 HP each time. When it dies, every Ragling dies, so focus Rag Man and only kill Raglings in the way.

901.0.name: Lil Blub

dodge.shots: 6 streams (whole heart each)
dodge.notes: Stand far, between two streams.

dodge.tell: jumps; below 25% HP 3-5 jumps in a row
dodge.shots: burst on landing; low HP: cardinal + diagonal shots each landing
dodge.notes: Off its rows, columns and diagonals at each landing.

901.0.on_death: 2-4 Small Leeches and a few seconds of projectile rain: keep moving.
901.0.notes: Small Leeches swarm it and block shots. It can't use its attacks while 6+ Small Leeches are in the room.

902.0.name: The Rainmaker

dodge.tell: projectiles appear at the far ends
dodge.shots: two horizontal lines fired from the room edges toward the centre
dodge.notes: Move vertically out of the lines.

dodge.shots: staggered ring; hovering shots then an 8-shot ring; big water ball popping into a random burst
dodge.notes: Distance and keep moving.

902.0.notes: Floats slowly toward Isaac. Killing it stops the rain.

913.0.name: Min-Min

dodge.shots: each Willo fires 3 outward
ring chases Isaac a few seconds

dodge.tell: she disappears, lights on the floor
dodge.shots: Willos rise from the lights, fire, vanish
dodge.notes: Stay off the lights.

913.0.phase_change: Phase 1 inside a drowned husk (max 4 Willos); phase 2 burns it off (max 7).
913.0.notes: Willos do no contact damage and die with her: shoot her.

62.3.name: Wormwood

dodge.shots: 4 cardinal shots in the air, then a zig-zag chase
messy spray
makes new pits where Isaac stood
